WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_daily_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_daily_price) AS avg_daily_price
  FROM rating_averages
), selected_ratings AS (
  SELECT ra.avg_daily_price, oa.avg_daily_price AS overall_avg_daily_price
  FROM rating_averages ra
  CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
  WHERE ra.avg_daily_price > oa.avg_daily_price
)
SELECT AVG(avg_daily_price) AS avg_daily_price,
       AVG(avg_daily_price - overall_avg_daily_price) AS avg_above_overall
FROM selected_ratings;
